Programmable Android launcher with AI-generated widgets, wallpapers, and live customization.

All data lives on your device. AI keys are stored in Android\'s hardware-backed encrypted preferences. No analytics, no tracking, no telemetry. Network requests go only to the AI provider you configured (when you ask the AI to do something) and to GitHub raw content (when you open the Showcase browser). Push notifications, when used by a widget, route through Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Made by an indie developer in the Netherlands · © 2026 iappyx
It\'s completely free — no ads, no tracking, no subscriptions. If it\'s earned a spot on your phone, a coffee helps keep it going.
